families.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

members.gloss: capable or worthy of being noticed
members.tone: The plain, unjudged term of the set — it rates a thing as able or worth noticing without saying whether the noticing is welcome, which is exactly what *obtrusive* adds.
A speech word: it grades how thickly the regional colouring comes through, not how plainly a thing shows itself.
Near-instrumental in feel — it frames the thing as something a look or a test turns up, where *perceptible* frames it as something the senses take in.
Pitches the same easy visibility at the observer's senses rather than at a search, which is what sets it apart from *detectable*.

members.gloss: capable of being seen or noticed
members.tone: The most guarded of the three — it grants only that the thing can be picked out, without *evident*'s suggestion that it announces itself.

members.gloss: capable of being seen or noticed
members.tone: Stronger than *discernible* on the same footing: what is evident presents itself rather than waiting to be made out.

members.gloss: capable of being seen or noticed
members.tone: The flattest of the three — a bare statement that observation is possible, carrying none of *evident*'s force.
Raises the degree rather than the ease — the thing stands out by how strongly it is set off, not by how little effort finding it takes.
Carries the same heightened degree as *marked*, but with the sense of a quality pushed forward until it cannot be missed.
The one member that judges: it puts the noticing at the top of the scale and calls it unwanted, where *marked* only measures how far the scale runs.

families.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

members.gloss: frightening because of an awareness of danger
members.tone: The mildest force here — fear pinned to a danger you can recognise, which makes it a warning rather than the sheer horror of *horrifying*.
Consternation at full weight — it knocks the composure sideways, where *dismaying* only unsettles it.
The gentler consternation: spirits sink rather than reel, and the thing is not condemned outright as *appalling* condemns it.
Condemns as much as it describes — the horror is charged to the thing as a fault, where *horrifying* only reports the effect.
Fright rather than full horror — the same sense worn lightly enough to sound almost decorous beside *horrifying*.
Keeps the verb's live action, the thing doing the horrifying to you as you watch, where *horrible* merely names the quality.
The plain, all-purpose word for the quality — it states the horror without staging it.
Nothing to do with looks here: a blunt, unadorned word for what provokes horror, and the flatness is the whole of its force.

members.gloss: causing fear or dread or terror
members.tone: Broad and unspecific — it names the terror without picturing it, where *fearsome* gives the thing a shape.

members.gloss: causing fear or dread or terror
members.tone: Grave and flat, treating the terror as a settled fact of the situation with none of the flourish of *direful*.

members.gloss: causing fear or dread or terror
members.tone: The heightened form, reaching for a weight that *dire* carries without effort.

members.gloss: causing fear or dread or terror
members.tone: Elevated, almost ceremonial — the terror is stated as an attribute the thing simply has, not an effect it works on you.

members.gloss: causing fear or dread or terror
members.tone: The participle turns the fear around: the thing is defined by the dread already aimed at it, where *dreadful* says it causes dread.

members.gloss: causing fear or dread or terror
members.tone: Says plainly that the thing causes dread — the workaday partner to *dread*'s elevation.

members.gloss: causing fear or dread or terror
members.tone: Points outward at what causes the fear rather than inward at whoever feels it, the opposite reading to the one the word's shape invites.

members.gloss: causing fear or dread or terror
members.tone: Concedes stature to what frightens — the terror it names is formidable, not merely nasty as in *horrible*.

families.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

members.gloss: continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place
members.tone: Flat and factual — the bare statement that a condition holds, without the warmth *lasting* can pick up.

members.gloss: continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place
members.tone: Softer than *permanent* — duration sounds like something the thing has rather than a status fixed onto it.
Makes long duration sound like constancy, where *enduring* makes it sound like resistance.
Long duration framed as strength, as though the thing had to hold out to reach it.
The strongest of the long-lasting three: not holding out like *enduring* but beyond decay altogether, which treats what it names as worth keeping.
Presents going on indefinitely as something to be envied rather than merely measured, where *perpetual* only records the running on.
Lofty and bookish — endlessness stated in the grandest available terms with no judgement attached to it.
Carries the same elevated, uncommitted weight as *aeonian*, adding nothing and softening nothing.
Solemn and absolute — it makes endlessness a property of the thing rather than a stretch of time, and still approves of nothing.
Warmer than *eternal* — the endlessness sounds like something held onto rather than a fact declared.
Endlessness as plain mechanism, running on without the grandeur *eternal* brings to the same span.
Frames endlessness as the plain absence of a stop, without the grandeur *eternal* brings or the warmth of *everlasting*.
Presses on the missing pause, so what continues indefinitely reads as relentless rather than simply long.

members.gloss: not created for a particular occasion
members.tone: Positional rather than evaluative — it marks a thing as kept ready for whatever comes instead of raised for one occasion.

families.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

members.gloss: having or indicating good health in body or mind; free from infirmity or disease
members.tone: The flat baseline of the family, a verdict passed on body or mind alike with none of the visible glow *rosy* insists on.

members.gloss: having the pinkish flush of health
members.tone: Reads health off the skin's colour instead of declaring it, offering evidence where *healthy* offers a judgement.

members.gloss: having the pinkish flush of health
members.tone: Puts the same pink flush in one place, the cheeks, which turns *flushed*'s observation into a portrait.

members.gloss: having the pinkish flush of health
members.tone: The single unadorned stroke of the pink-flush words, letting the glow stand alone rather than pinning it to a face as *rosy-cheeked* does.

members.gloss: having the pinkish flush of health
members.tone: Spells out where *rosy*'s glow sits, and the extra word makes it fonder and more picturesque.
Health with energy spilling out of it, so where *healthy* reports a condition this one moves.

members.gloss: possessing the tone and resiliency of healthy tissue
members.tone: Judges health by touch, tone and resilience in the tissue itself, not the colour *rosy* shows nor the vigour *bouncing* spends.
The unshowy top of the scale, excellent condition stated without a flourish where *hale* reaches for one.
Says the same excellent condition as *good* with the ring of a verdict rather than a compliment.

members.gloss: exhibiting or restored to vigorous good health
members.tone: Formal and a little grand, and it covers vigour regained as readily as vigour never lost.

members.gloss: exhibiting or restored to vigorous good health
members.tone: Frames that same vigorous health as entirety, leaning on the restored side where *hale* leans on the display.
Approves through appetite, abundance taken with relish, so it praises how someone eats rather than how they are.

members.gloss: endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health
members.tone: Treats great health of body or mind as something carried in the constitution, possessed as much as shown.

members.gloss: endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health
members.tone: Pitches the same great bodily or mental health as raw force, louder and more physical than *full-blooded*.

members.gloss: endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health
members.tone: Sounds like a boast, great health of body or mind worn as vitality rather than merely reported as *healthy* would.
Clinical and purely negative in shape, saying only that jaundice is absent and carrying none of the approval the rest of the family trades in.

members.gloss: serving or tending to provoke, excite, or stimulate; stimulating discussion or exciting controversy
members.tone: The neutral base of the family - it names the power to excite, stimulate or set off controversy without settling whether that is welcome, where *provoking* fixes the reaction as anger.

members.gloss: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment
members.tone: Flat and clinical for what it describes, labelling a thing as anger-producing by disposition rather than catching the anger or resentment in the act.

members.gloss: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment
members.tone: The participle keeps the effect live - anger and resentment being stirred now, where *agitative* states a settled property.

members.gloss: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment
members.tone: Blunt and personal beside the clinical *agitative* - the anger or resentment it names is felt as an affront by someone in particular.
The disturbance is set before you as something to be met, so the discomfort arrives with a demand attached rather than a verdict.
Here the disturbance pulls instead of repelling - what unsettles is also what fascinates, where *challenging* wants an answer out of you.

members.gloss: capable of producing violent emotion or arousing controversy
members.tone: Names a load waiting to go off, the violent feeling or the controversy stored in the thing and not yet released, where *inflammatory* names something already doing the work.
Carries the image of a fire set on purpose, so stirring people to act or to rise is treated as damage waiting to happen.
A bare, near-technical label for the same power to move people to action or revolt, with none of the heat *incendiary* puts under it.
The heat is the whole point - it treats the thing as what sets the action or the rebellion alight, not merely the occasion for it.
Points past the blaze to the hand behind it, naming what starts the action or the rising rather than how fiercely it burns.
Contempt running both ways - it belittles those stirred to act as a mob and denies the stirring any cause worth having.
The gravest word here - it treats rousing people to action or revolt as an offence against authority, where *incendiary* only warns of the fire.

members.gloss: rousing to activity or heightened action as by spurring or goading
members.tone: The one stirring in the family that is welcome, though the spurring and goading in it keep an edge of being driven to act rather than persuaded.

families.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

members.gloss: without hope because there seems to be no possibility of comfort or success
members.tone: The family's plain verdict, hope absent because no comfort or success looks possible — a reading of the odds where *despairing* is a reading of the feeling.
The most degrading member: utter resignation or hopelessness worn openly, so that the giving-up is itself what gets judged.
A bare negation covering the same utter resignation or hopelessness as *abject*, but with the contempt drained out and understatement left to carry it.
Paints the little-or-no hope rather than measuring it, and paints it unrelieved, which is what puts it past *dim*.
The same shortage of hope felt as bareness and exposure rather than as the darkness of *black*.
The mildest of the three, since it sits on the “little” rather than the “no” — hope faint but not yet out.

members.gloss: arising from or marked by despair or loss of hope
members.tone: Points at the despair itself, whether a thing arises from that loss of hope or merely bears its mark, where *hopeless* points at the prospects.

members.gloss: arising from or marked by despair or loss of hope
members.tone: The straining side of the same despair — something arising from lost hope rather than merely showing it, so it pushes where *despairing* only mourns.
A sunk, settled state with hope gone or all but gone, heavier than *dim* and far quieter than *desperate*.
Puts that same absent-or-nearly-absent hope in the body, a sickness felt rather than the low weight of *despondent*.
Hopelessness that is marked or shown in a way inviting pity, not the reproach *abject* invites.

members.gloss: having no prospect or hope of a future
members.tone: Turns the loss forward — neither prospect nor hope of a future — a flat structural verdict beside the mood of *forlorn*.
Two failures at once, no power to function and no help at hand, which makes it sound like a plea rather than the verdict *hopeless* delivers.
Carries the same inability and the same want of help as *helpless*, but as a settled condition rather than a moment of one, so it sounds past rescue.
The member aimed at what admits no solution rather than at anyone, a flat statement that none is to be hoped for, carrying no reproach of its own.

families.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

members.gloss: not serious in content or attitude or behavior
members.tone: The family's plain term and its widest, attaching to content, attitude or behaviour alike without the picture of a hollow head that the compounds beside it supply.
Blunt mockery that explains the unseriousness by putting air where the thinking should be, where *frivolous* just reports the lack.
Whirl rather than vacancy, the lightest hit in the group and closer to teasing than to the contempt in *empty-headed*.
Mockery that goes past unseriousness to vacancy - it does not merely find the person frivolous but alleges there is nothing inside to be serious with, where *dizzy* only sets the head spinning.
Mockery by weighing the brain, making the frivolity ridiculous rather than merely noting it as *silly* does.
Lightness with a lift to it, the unseriousness felt as high spirits, so it stings far less than *empty-headed*.
The same charge as *giddy* stated as a property of the head rather than a mood, and a light head is still not the vacant one *empty-headed* alleges.
The unhyphenated twin of *light-headed*, identical in force: a light head, not an empty one.
The plainest and most forgiving word for the fault, naming the frivolity without a metaphor for the head and leaving room for fondness that *airheaded* forecloses.
Whim read as unreliability, so it warns about conduct where *head-in-the-clouds* only pictures a drift.
The lightest reading of a life run by whim and fancy: loose and ungoverned rather than a fault to be answered for.
Indulgent almost to fondness, the whim and fancy carrying the person off rather than damning them, unlike *scatterbrained*'s charge of disorder.
Whim as scatter: the fault is that attention will not hold together, which *flighty* leaves as mere changeability.
The verdict is built in, the levity being out of place, so the word rebukes a manner rather than diagnosing a mind as *empty-headed* does.
The measured version of *flippant*'s fault, locating the misplaced levity in a cast of mind instead of throwing it back at the offender.
It runs to two things at once, the silly and the trivial, so the dismissal is as much about weightlessness as about foolishness.

families.axis: holding the power to settle an outcome → settling it with a weight that shuts everything else down

members.gloss: determining or having the power to determine an outcome
members.tone: The family's plain baseline, covering both the thing that actually determines an outcome and the thing merely holding the power to, and taking no view on how the outcome falls.

members.gloss: having the power or quality of deciding
members.tone: The plainest member — the power or quality of deciding stated with no formality at all, where *determinative* says as much in a starched collar.

members.gloss: having the power or quality of deciding
members.tone: Formal and analytic, naming the deciding power as a property a factor holds rather than anything it is seen to do.

members.gloss: having the power or quality of deciding
members.tone: Formal, and tilted toward deciding as a standing quality, where *determining* is that same power caught in the act.

members.gloss: having the power or quality of deciding
members.tone: The deciding power shown in use rather than merely held, which gives it a motion *determinant* lacks.

members.gloss: having momentous consequences; of decisive importance
members.tone: Adds gravity to plain importance — consequences big enough to feel handed down, with a shadow across them that *deciding* has no room for.

members.gloss: having momentous consequences; of decisive importance
members.tone: The darkest way this family has of saying momentous — it makes decisive importance sound like doom arriving, where *fateful* only makes it weighty.

members.gloss: putting an end to all debate or action
members.tone: Force with no courtesy in it: rather than settle an outcome it slams the door on debate and action alike, leaving nothing to answer.
